entities.summary: The Mfecanecode: zul promoted to code: zu was a historical period of heightened military conflict and migration associated with state formation and expansion in Southern Africa. At its broadest, the period lasted from the late eighteenth century to the mid-nineteenth century, but scholars often focus on an intensive period from the 1810s to the 1840s. Mfecane was a conflict.
